audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[] side/rating disagreed with content win[] on every one of 7 rows — full said Thresh L1-3, Skill L4-6/2items; content said Skill L1-3, Thresh L4-6, Sona 2items. Full-layer breakdown fields were also generic template prose ('chord the contacts', 'aura economy') with no real ability names.
audit.why: Content's reasoning is grounded in real kit facts (Thresh has no sustain early, hook range and Flay peel win mid, Lantern saves, then Sona's Diminuendo/Crescendo out-scale at 2 items) and matches this champion's actual pattern; full-layer text was templated filler that could be pasted onto any enemy.
audit.corrected: Rewrote all 7 phases[].side/.rating to match content win[] (already correct on disk, no win[] edit needed), rewrote each why with the grounded reasoning, and rewrote breakdown.early/mid/cooldowns/trading/feeding/carry/late, ahead, tradeGood, tradeBad, enemyWin, and loading using real ability names (Death Sentence, Flay, Lantern, The Box, Hymn of Valor, Aria, Song of Celerity, Crescendo, Diminuendo).

audit.why: Level 6 (Box + hook) and first item (Lantern pick pressure) and two-items (Sona's Crescendo/Diminuendo scaling) power spikes are now correctly reflected in the rewritten phases and breakdown.spikes/carry.
